## `@ix-xs/djs-bot`

Le framework lui-même.

```ts
import { /* ... */ } from "@ix-xs/djs-bot";
```

### Fonctions

| Export | Ce que c'est | Documenté dans |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `anyOf()` | Passes when **at least one** of the given guards passes. | [Gardes](/commands/guards/) |
| `botHasPermission()` | Requires the *bot* to have all of the given permissions **in the current channel** (channel overwrites included, as computed by Discord). | [Gardes](/commands/guards/) |
| `buildCommandTree()` | Builds the full desired command tree (ignoring per-command scoping). | [Déployer les commandes](/production/deploying/) |
| `clearCommands()` | Removes **all** of the app's commands from one scope (a guild, or global). | [Déployer les commandes](/production/deploying/) |
| `commandsEqual()` | Whether a local command and the one Discord returned describe the same thing. | [Déployer les commandes](/production/deploying/) |
| `commandToJSON()` | Converts one slash command definition to the REST JSON body Discord expects. | [Déployer les commandes](/production/deploying/) |
| `computeIntents()` | Derives the minimal set of intents and partials for the given events. | [Événements et intents](/events/events-and-intents/) |
| `confirm()` | Shows a yes/no dialog and resolves to the user's choice (or `false` on timeout). | [Pagination et confirmation](/components/pagination/) |
| `cooldown()` | Per-invocation cooldown. | [Gardes](/commands/guards/) |
| `createAuditLog()` | Creates an `AuditLog`. | [Journal d'audit](/data/audit/) |
| `createCache()` | Creates a `TTLCache`. | [Cache et résolution d'entités](/data/cache/) |
| `createCircuitBreaker()` | Creates a `CircuitBreaker`. | [Résilience](/production/resilience/) |
| `createFeatureFlags()` | Creates a `FeatureFlags` service. | [Feature flags](/data/flags/) |

| `createLogger()` | Creates a root `Logger`. | [Journalisation](/production/logging/) |
| `createRateLimiter()` | Creates a `RateLimiter`. | [Résilience](/production/resilience/) |
| `createStore()` | Builds a full `KVStore` from a minimal `KVBackend`. | [Store](/data/store/) |
| `customIdKey()` | Extracts just the routing key from a raw customId without decoding params. | [Boutons](/components/buttons/) |
| `decodeCustomId()` | Decodes a customId back into its routing key and typed params. | [Boutons](/components/buttons/) |
| `defineBot()` | Creates a `Bot`. | [Configuration](/basics/configuration/) |
| `defineButton()` | Defines a button. | [Boutons](/components/buttons/) |
| `defineChannelSelect()` | Defines a native channel select menu. | [Menus de sélection](/components/select-menus/) |

| `defineJob()` | Defines a scheduled job. | [Tâches planifiées](/events/jobs/) |
| `defineMentionableSelect()` | Defines a native mentionable (users + roles) select menu. | [Menus de sélection](/components/select-menus/) |
| `defineMessageCommand()` | Defines a message context-menu command. | [Menus contextuels](/commands/context-menus/) |
| `defineModal()` | Defines a modal. | [Modales](/components/modals/) |
| `definePlugin()` | Defines a cross-cutting plugin (hooks, middleware, capabilities). | [Plugins et hooks](/architecture/plugins/) |
| `defineRoleSelect()` | Defines a native role select menu. | [Menus de sélection](/components/select-menus/) |
| `defineSelectMenu()` | Defines a string select menu (a custom list of options). | [Menus de sélection](/components/select-menus/) |
| `defineService()` | Defines an injectable service with explicit dependencies. | [Services](/architecture/services/) |
| `defineStore()` | Wraps a `KVStore` as a service definition so it's injectable as `ctx.services.<token>` and discovered from a `*.service.ts` file. | [Store](/data/store/) |

| `defineUserSelect()` | Defines a native user select menu. | [Menus de sélection](/components/select-menus/) |
| `deployCommands()` | Deploys commands, honouring per-command scoping: - commands with no `guilds` go **global**, - commands with `guilds` go to **those guilds**. | [Déployer les commandes](/production/deploying/) |
| `describeInteraction()` | Summarises an interaction as a kind plus a readable name - what a logging or metrics plugin wants to tag its records with. | [L'objet ctx](/basics/context/) |
| `dmOnly()` | Requires the interaction to happen in DMs. | [Gardes](/commands/guards/) |
| `encodeCustomId()` | Encodes a routing key and typed params into a Discord-safe customId. | [Boutons](/components/buttons/) |
| `env()` | Reads an environment variable (also consulting a `.env` file), with an optional fallback. | [Configuration](/basics/configuration/) |
| `fail()` | Signals a guard failed, with a user-facing reason. | [Gardes](/commands/guards/) |
| `featureEnabled()` | A guard that blocks a command/component when a feature flag is off for the guild. | [Feature flags](/data/flags/) |
| `guard()` | Creates a named guard. | [Gardes](/commands/guards/) |
| `guildOwnerOnly()` | Restricts usage to the owner of the server the interaction happens in. | [Gardes](/commands/guards/) |
| `hasPermission()` | Requires the invoking member to have all of the given permissions **in the current channel** (channel overwrites included, as computed by Discord). | [Gardes](/commands/guards/) |
| `hasRole()` | Requires the invoking member to hold **at least one** of the given roles. | [Gardes](/commands/guards/) |
| `inChannel()` | Restricts usage to specific channel ids. | [Gardes](/commands/guards/) |
| `inGuild()` | Requires the interaction to happen inside a guild. | [Gardes](/commands/guards/) |
| `isBot()` | Robust, cross-realm check that a value is a `Bot` - use this instead of `instanceof`, which breaks across the CJS/ESM dual-package boundary. | [Configuration](/basics/configuration/) |
| `isBotError()` | Type guard for `BotError`. | [Erreurs](/api/errors/) |
| `isHiddenChannel()` | Whether a channel is one the bot cannot view, sent by Discord with its name and details withheld ("obfuscated"). | [Cache et résolution d'entités](/data/cache/) |
| `isShardChild()` | True when the current process is a shard child spawned by a manager (so it should run the bot), rather than the manager itself. | [Sharding](/production/sharding/) |
| `launchShardManager()` | Launches a `ShardingManager` for the given entry file. | [Sharding](/production/sharding/) |
| `loadEnvFile()` | Loads a `.env` file into `process.env` (without overwriting existing vars). | [Configuration](/basics/configuration/) |
| `loggerAuditSink()` | A sink that writes each entry to the structured logger. | [Journal d'audit](/data/audit/) |
| `memoryAuditSink()` | An in-memory sink (bounded ring buffer). | [Journal d'audit](/data/audit/) |
| `memoryStore()` | Creates an in-memory `KVStore` (fast, non-durable). | [Store](/data/store/) |
| `normalizeSharding()` | Normalises the loose `sharding` config into full options. | [Sharding](/production/sharding/) |
| `not()` | Inverts a guard: passes when it fails. | [Gardes](/commands/guards/) |
| `oneOf()` | Builds a codec for a parameter that must be one of a fixed set of strings, so `ctx.params` is typed as that union instead of a plain `string`. | [Boutons](/components/buttons/) |
| `ownerOnly()` | Restricts usage to specific user ids. | [Gardes](/commands/guards/) |
| `paginate()` | Sends a paginated message with prev/next (and first/last) controls, updating in place as the user navigates and disabling the controls on timeout. | [Pagination et confirmation](/components/pagination/) |
| `parseSchedule()` | Parses a duration, a cron expression or a macro into a schedule descriptor. | [Tâches planifiées](/events/jobs/) |
| `pass()` | Signals a guard passed. | [Gardes](/commands/guards/) |
| `planDeployment()` | Partitions the registry's commands into a global set and per-guild sets based on each command's `guilds` field. | [Déployer les commandes](/production/deploying/) |
| `rateLimit()` | A guard that allows `limit` uses per `window`, per scope (default `"user"`). | [Résilience](/production/resilience/) |
| `retry()` | Retries an async function with exponential backoff + jitter. | [Résilience](/production/resilience/) |
| `sqliteStore()` | Creates a durable `KVStore` backed by SQLite (via node-comfort's built-in `node:sqlite`). | [Store](/data/store/) |
| `startHealthServer()` | Starts the health server. | [Santé et métriques](/production/health/) |
| `storeAuditSink()` | A sink that persists entries in a `KVStore` (one key per entry). | [Journal d'audit](/data/audit/) |
| `subcommand()` | Defines one subcommand with its own typed options. | [Sous-commandes](/commands/subcommands/) |
| `timeout()` | Rejects if `promise` doesn't settle within `ms`. | [Résilience](/production/resilience/) |
| `timestamp()` | Renders a Discord timestamp (auto-localised in each user's client). | [Mentions, horodatages et pings sûrs](/messages/formatting/) |
| `toAutocompleteChoices()` | Turns what an autocomplete handler returned into suggestions Discord accepts. | [Options et autocomplétion](/commands/options/) |
| `toPrometheus()` | Renders a status as the Prometheus text exposition format, so the endpoint can be scraped directly without an exporter. | [Santé et métriques](/production/health/) |

### Classes

| Export | Ce que c'est | Documenté dans |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Bot` | The bot application. | [Configuration](/basics/configuration/) |
| `BotError` | A framework error with a stable code, an actionable hint, and a docs link. | [Erreurs](/api/errors/) |
| `CircuitBreaker` | A circuit breaker: after too many failures it "opens" and fails fast for a cool-off period, then tries again ("half-open") before fully recovering. | [Résilience](/production/resilience/) |
| `CircuitOpenError` | Error thrown when calls are rejected because the circuit is open. | [Résilience](/production/resilience/) |
| `Container` | Resolves service definitions and holds their singleton instances. | [Services](/architecture/services/) |
| `Logger` | Structured logger with level filtering and child bindings. | [Journalisation](/production/logging/) |
| `RateLimiter` | A fixed-window rate limiter, keyed by an arbitrary string. | [Résilience](/production/resilience/) |
| `Registry` | Holds every definition and exposes typed lookups. | [Structure du projet](/basics/project-layout/) |
| `TTLCache` | An in-memory TTL + LRU cache with single-flight fetching. | [Cache et résolution d'entités](/data/cache/) |

| `SelectType` | The five kinds of select menu Discord supports. | [Menus de sélection](/components/select-menus/) |
| `SelectVisualOptions` | Visual configuration for a built string select menu. | [Menus de sélection](/components/select-menus/) |
| `SemanticReplyOptions` | Extra options for the semantic reply helpers. | [L'objet ctx](/basics/context/) |
| `ServiceDefinition` | A service definition. | [Services](/architecture/services/) |
| `ServiceMap` | Global service map. | [Services](/architecture/services/) |
| `ShardingOptions` | Sharding configuration. | [Sharding](/production/sharding/) |
| `ShowModalFn` | Opens a modal as the response to an interaction. | [L'objet ctx](/basics/context/) |
| `SubcommandDefinition` | A single subcommand (the leaf that actually runs). | [Sous-commandes](/commands/subcommands/) |
| `SubcommandGroupDefinition` | A subcommand group (a folder of subcommands). | [Sous-commandes](/commands/subcommands/) |
| `SubcommandInput` | Input accepted by `subcommand`. | [Sous-commandes](/commands/subcommands/) |
| `Theme` | The accent colours of the built-in `ctx.reply.success/error/info/warn` embeds. | [Formulations et thème](/basics/wording-and-theme/) |
| `TriggerContext` | Context passed to a message trigger handler. | [Déclencheurs de messages](/events/triggers/) |
| `TriggerDefinition` | A registered message trigger (auto-responder). | [Déclencheurs de messages](/events/triggers/) |
| `TriggerInput` | Input accepted by `defineTrigger`. | [Déclencheurs de messages](/events/triggers/) |
| `TriggerMode` | How a string pattern is compared against message content. | [Déclencheurs de messages](/events/triggers/) |
| `TriggerPattern` | A pattern: a substring/keyword, a RegExp, or a custom predicate. | [Déclencheurs de messages](/events/triggers/) |
| `TTLCacheOptions` | Options for `TTLCache`. | [Cache et résolution d'entités](/data/cache/) |
| `UpdateFn` | Callable component-update helper (edits the source message). | [L'objet ctx](/basics/context/) |
| `UserCommandContext` | Context passed to user context-menu command handlers. | [Menus contextuels](/commands/context-menus/) |
| `UserCommandDefinition` | A registered user context-menu command (right-click a user → Apps). | [Menus contextuels](/commands/context-menus/) |

| `UserSelectDefinition` | A registered user select menu. | [Menus de sélection](/components/select-menus/) |

### Réexporté depuis discord.js

Par commodité, pour qu'un bot ait rarement besoin d'importer directement depuis `discord.js` :

`ActionRowBuilder`, `ActivityType`, `AttachmentBuilder`, `ButtonStyle`, `ChannelType`, `Collection`, `Colors`, `EmbedBuilder`, `Events`, `GatewayIntentBits`, `MessageFlags`, `Partials`, `PermissionFlagsBits`, `TextInputStyle`, `TimestampStyles`.

## `@ix-xs/djs-bot/plugins`

Les plugins officiels.

```ts
import { /* ... */ } from "@ix-xs/djs-bot/plugins";
```

### Fonctions

| Export | Ce que c'est | Documenté dans |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `antiSpam()` | Rejects interactions from users who exceed a per-window rate limit - a simple guard against interaction spam, applied globally to every interaction. | [Plugins et hooks](/architecture/plugins/) |
| `commandLogger()` | Logs a structured line for every interaction (with duration), using the per-interaction correlation logger. | [Plugins et hooks](/architecture/plugins/) |
| `errorReporter()` | Forwards every unhandled interaction error to your reporter (e.g. | [Plugins et hooks](/architecture/plugins/) |
| `maintenance()` | Blocks all interactions with a maintenance notice, except for allow-listed users. | [Plugins et hooks](/architecture/plugins/) |

### Types

| Export | Ce que c'est | Documenté dans |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `AntiSpamOptions` | Options for `antiSpam`. | [Plugins et hooks](/architecture/plugins/) |
| `CommandLoggerOptions` | Options for `commandLogger`. | [Plugins et hooks](/architecture/plugins/) |
| `ErrorReporterOptions` | Options for `errorReporter`. | [Plugins et hooks](/architecture/plugins/) |
| `MaintenanceOptions` | Options for `maintenance`. | [Plugins et hooks](/architecture/plugins/) |

## `@ix-xs/djs-bot/testing`

Le harnais de test. À n'importer que depuis vos tests.

```ts
import { /* ... */ } from "@ix-xs/djs-bot/testing";
```

### Fonctions

| Export | Ce que c'est | Documenté dans |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `createHarness()` | Creates a test harness. | [Tests](/production/testing/) |

### Types

| Export | Ce que c'est | Documenté dans |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CapturedReply` | A single captured response produced by a handler under test. | [Tests](/production/testing/) |
| `Harness` | A harness bound to an optional `Bot` (for its services). | [Tests](/production/testing/) |
| `HarnessResult` | The result of running a handler through the harness. | [Tests](/production/testing/) |
